meta.source: The Messages API's answer once the prepaid credit is used up, in its first reported form (docs/design.md §16, Other M12 facts). Not recorded: used-up credit can't be provoked on the developer's key, so it is written in the API's error shape, as the other cases that can't be provoked are built in the tests.
